purpose: Prespecified post-theory sensitivity campaign for horizon growth and saturated outstanding-record envelopes; no configuration is selected from observed outcomes

scenarios.name: front-blockers-1
scenarios.description: For each task type, the first launched audit is withheld until after the learning horizon and every later audit returns at the next boundary.

scenarios.name: front-blockers-4
scenarios.description: For each task type, the first four launched audits are withheld until after the learning horizon and every later audit returns at the next boundary.

world_reuse: For each truth and seed, one stream of 2048 worlds is generated; each shorter horizon uses its exact prefix, and every method/scenario at that horizon uses the same prefix.
retention: One final row per run with launch counts, exposures, exclusions, and the exact saturated unresolved-mass envelope.
